functions.description: Returns a constant, human-readable string that identifies the shim/library version. Typical usage is to call this once at startup or for logging/diagnostics to retrieve the version string; no arguments are required and the function has C linkage for use from C or C++.
requirements: The returned pointer refers to a constant string; the caller must not modify the contents.
The returned string must not be freed or deleted by the caller (ownership is not transferred).
Lifetime/thread-safety of the returned pointer is not documented; assume it remains valid as a static string unless otherwise specified (details unknown).
